title: Dev Angel
tagline: Any developer can seek instant video mentoring on their issues
description: Many developer issues are lost in discord and Stack Overflow doesnt enable live debugging. Dev Angel enables live debugging with mentors (or angels, as we call them). Choose how much you pay the mentor by posting a bounty amount. Chat with the mentor using Push; debug live over Huddle01 and mint a video NFT using LivePeer over IPFS to let your debug session be available to others for watching and learning.
how_its_made: Faced many issues while integrating Graph (arrays in smart contract cannot be emitted in the event; We modified our events schema.), integrating Push (api key was not available; so figured one from some random example project).
